attempts.text:
**The window starts on a single spine column.** Column 0, `tmaR`, is carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 2% of calls; the model names it in 98% of calls with 0.11 bits. Then columns 1 to 79 are fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 26 to 75% of calls.

**The first fork is the most hesitant place in the window.** Column 1, a microcompartment family, is named in 54% of calls and costs 2.64 bits, in a region of plasticity in 72% of calls; column 2, `yeeW`, 2.19 bits and 71%. A second branch of 18 families runs through columns 1 to 18, carried by 16% of chromosomes, shell families such as `eutP`, `pduU` and `pduT` to `pduB`, [[propanediol utilization microcompartment]]. Further branches follow: 3 families at columns 20 to 22, 3 at 23 to 25, 3 at 27 to 29.

**Persistent families return in the middle.** The `cob` genes `cobU`, `cobS` and `cobT` sit at columns 23 to 25, carried by 87 to 89% of chromosomes, [[cobinamide biosynthesis]]. Columns 47 to 51 are variable, carried by 65 to 67%, all persistent: `dcm`, `vsr`, `yedA`, `yedI`, `yodC`. A branch of 6 families at columns 40 to 45, carried by 18 to 22%, runs `ybtA` to an integrase, [[yersiniabactin biosynthesis]].

**The window ends in the flagellar genes.** Columns 59 to 78 carry `fliP` to `fliD`, persistent, [[flagellar assembly]], with a branch of 15 persistent families at columns 64 to 78, carried by 10 to 34%. The model names 81% of genes over the window, 0.92 bits on average. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.49 against 0.41 bits, and names fewer genes, 70% against 92%.

label: tmaR
facts:
WINDOW: the tmaR window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor tmaR, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 1,713 to 1,792 from dnaA. Read in 539 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying tmaR once); 43,120 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 81% of genes, 0.92 bits on average (perplexity 2.7 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 20,437 calls, named 96%, 0.31 bits; shell 20,842 calls, named 73%, 1.32 bits; cloud 1,841 calls, named 18%, 3.10 bits. Outside an RGP 22,852 calls, named 92%, 0.41 bits; inside an RGP 20,268 calls, named 70%, 1.49 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 56 fork, 23 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.49 against 0.41 bits) and names fewer genes (70% against 92%); 20,268 of the 43,120 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 1 ("EutP/PduV family microcompartment syste…") 2.64 bits, RGP 72%; column 2 (yeeW) 2.19 bits, RGP 71%; column 13 (yeeJ) 1.24 bits, RGP 67%. The 22 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 82%, 1.17 bits on average; the other 58 columns: named 81%, 0.82 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 1-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 26-75%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 2%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 2%. Genes: tmaR. named 98%; 0.11 bits.
2. columns 1-79 (79 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 26-75%. named 54-89% (mean 81%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 1, named 54%, 2.64 bits.
